# stabbed.wtf

virex; independent software researcher, 4+ years (started ~2021).
focused on systems programming, UI/UX, and vulnerability research.

## projects

- **Beetrap**: Go honeypot with real-time TUI logging.
- **SniffCLI**: Lightweight Go packet sniffer and network sentry.
- **Lens**: photography — nature, cats, spiders, misc
- **Now**: what i'm actively building, reading, and learning right now

## stack

React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript, Rust, Python, GoLang, Node.js, Express, better-sqlite3
